text.value: Every night or almost every night
**Lakeside Community Health Check** (fictional sample form). Staff complete this form with the participant. Choose the visit first.
Use the format LH-0000: LH, a dash, then 4 digits.
The date cannot be before 2026 or in the future.
Has the participant signed the study consent form?
**STOP.** Do not continue: people can only take part after signing the consent form.
The date cannot be before 1900 or in the future.
1. What is your date of birth?
**STOP.** This person is under 18 and cannot take part. Do not continue.
3. What is the highest level of education you have completed?
4. How many people live in your household, including you?
'None of these' cannot be ticked together with a condition.
5. Has a doctor or nurse ever told you that you have any of these conditions? Tick all that apply.
6. Are you currently taking medicine for high blood pressure?
7. Do you smoke tobacco (cigarettes, cigars, pipe, water-pipe or similar)?
8. On a day when you smoke, how many cigarettes (or similar) do you usually smoke?
9. In a usual week, on how many days are you active for at least 30 minutes (for example brisk walking, cycling, sport or heavy housework)?
10. On a usual day, how many portions of fruit and vegetables do you eat? One portion is about a handful.
11. Over the past week, how much energy have you had?
0 = No energy at all, 100 = Full of energy
12. Over the past month, how often have you had trouble sleeping?
13. In the past 2 weeks, how often have you had the following?
Enter a height from 100 to 230 cm.
Measure without shoes. Enter one decimal place, e.g. 165.0
Enter a weight from 30 to 250 kg.
Light clothing, no shoes. Enter one decimal place, e.g. 72.4
Enter a value from 40 to 150, lower than the systolic value.
Section D: Result and follow-up (staff to complete)
This reading is 140/90 mmHg or higher. Give the participant the advice leaflet and invite them to the 3 follow-up visits.
Has the participant agreed to the 3 follow-up visits?
Complete this form only if the participant agreed to the follow-up visits. These details identify the participant: record them only here.
May we send text message reminders before each visit?
Staff notes (do not write names, addresses or phone numbers here)
The date cannot be before 2026 or in the future.
F1. Date of visit (or date of last contact attempt)
F2. Did the visit take place?
F3. Main reason the visit did not take place
Enter a value from 40 to 150, lower than the systolic value.
Enter a weight from 30 to 250 kg.
Light clothing, no shoes. Enter one decimal place, e.g. 72.4
F6. Are you currently taking medicine for high blood pressure?
F7. On how many of the last 7 days did you take your blood pressure medicine?
F8. In the past 2 weeks, how often have you had the following?
F9. Since the last visit, have you stayed overnight in hospital, visited an emergency department, or been told you have a new health condition?
Complete one Health event form for each event.
The date cannot be before 2026 or in the future.
H3. Number of nights in hospital
H4. Was the event related to the heart or blood pressure?
H5. Brief description (no names or other identifying details)
Staff notes (do not write names, addresses or phone numbers here)
